noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

metricExpression.description:
The metric expression to evaluate and store on this field.
The metric will always be evaluated over the past day, but using window or other [aggregation functions](ExpressionEngineFunction)
allows for the value to be calculated over a larger time frame.

interval.description: The interval for which to evaluate the #metricExpression. Matches the field {@link FieldStoredMetricCache#interval}.

cronExpression.description:
The {@link CronSchedule#cronExpression} of how often this cached field should be updated.
A {@link CronJob} will be generated (but not upserted) with this expression and linked to the {@link FieldStoredMetricCache#cronJob} field.

disabled.description: The opposite of {@link FieldStoredMetricCache#enabled}. By default, this cache will be enabled.

title:
This annotation does not automatically generate any seed data. It is used to simplify the process of creating an
{@link FieldStoredMetricCache} instance and provide self documenting code.

Fields on entity types that have this annotation can easily generate the matching {@link FieldStoredMetricCache} and {@link CronJob}
objects, by calling the {@link FieldStoredMetricCache#generateSeedDataForAllAnnotations} function. See the documentation
on that function for more details.

**Note:** If the seed data is updated, then this annotation will be invalid but there will be no indication of the difference.
This is similar to if you used normal documentation to describe how the field was updated.
name: Ann.MetricCache
